```yaml
name: Database Export

on:
  schedule:
    - cron: '0 0 * * 0'  # Weekly on Sunday at midnight
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  export-database:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '18'
          cache: 'npm'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      - name: Setup database export
        run: |
          mkdir -p ./exports
          echo "Setting up database export environment"
        env:
          NODE_ENV: production

      - name: Export sanitized database
        run: |
          npm run export-db
        env:
          DATABASE_URL: ${{ secrets.DATABASE_URL }}
          EXPORT_PATH: ./exports/sanitized-db-${{ github.run_id }}.sqlite
          SANITIZE_CONFIG: ./config/sanitize.json

      - name: Compress database export
        run: |
          cd ./exports
          tar -czf bookhive-db-export-${{ github.run_id }}.tar.gz *.sqlite
          rm *.sqlite

      - name: Upload database artifact
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: bookhive-database-export-${{ github.run_id }}
          path: ./exports/bookhive-db-export-${{ github.run_id }}.tar.gz
          retention-days: 30

      - name: Cleanup exports directory
        run: rm -rf ./exports

  deploy-endpoint:
    needs: export-database
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    if: github.ref == 'refs/heads/main'
    steps:
      - name: Deploy HTTP endpoint
        run: |
          echo "Deploying protected HTTP endpoint for database access"
          # This would typically involve deploying to a server or cloud function
          # Implementation depends on your deployment infrastructure
        env:
          DEPLOY_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.DEPLOY_TOKEN }}
          ENDPOINT_SECRET: ${{ secrets.ENDPOINT_SECRET }}
```
